source.included: the thirteen declared non-turtle_ folders and their .blp files
source.excluded: all .tga files and every turtle_ custom-content folder
source.provenance: supplied by the user from the local WorldMap export
source.licenseOrPermission: supplied by the user for this local integration; redistribution rights are not documented

runtime.encoding: BLP2 encoding 2, alpha depth 8, alpha encoding 7
runtime.rename: the Raid basename prefix prevents collisions with all other shipped map textures; source pixels and BLP payloads are copied unchanged

selection.preferred: the exact raid or floor key returned by GetMapInfo
selection.fallback: the default map for a raid-instance name returned by GetInstanceInfo or the available location-text APIs
selection.persistence: the last confirmed raid map is retained only while IsInInstance reports a raid instance
selection.manualFallback: /umap raid <mapName> while the world map is closed; /umap raid off clears it
selection.unsafeOperations: no inferred internal map ID is passed to SetMapZoom
